proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 183 article gives Malayalam amma mother, goddess (esp. Kāḷi); interj. (also ammē, ammammā); ammamma mother's mother; ammān, ammāvan, ammāman, ammōn, ammōman maternal uncle; ammāyi, ammāvi maternal aunt, uncle's wife, mother-in-law; ammiṇi affectionate appellation esp. of infants,…. The Byari survey form umma “mother” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
